description:
Cast Abdel Adrian by paying {4}{W}.
Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, exiling Clever Impersonator until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Clever Impersonator leaves the battlefield, triggering its second ability, returning Wormfang Drake from exile to the battlefield.
Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, triggering its first ability, exiling Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Clever Impersonator from exile to the battlefield as a copy of Wormfang Drake.
Clever Impersonator enters the battlefield, triggering its first ability, exiling Wormfang Drake.
Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, triggering its second ability, returning Abdel Adrian from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.name: Clever Impersonator
uses.cardState: as a copy of Wormfang Drake
